n7e260f9917.headline: Pensana offered £4m UK government grant for Saltend project
n7e260f9917.summary: The UK Secretary of State for Business and Trade offered Pensana a grant of up to £4 million for a rare earth oxide separation facility. The plant would be built in the Humber Freeport at Saltend, England.
n7e260f9917.why: Rare earth oxides are critical inputs for magnets used in electric vehicles and wind turbines, so domestic processing capacity is a strategic supply issue.

n523606c92c.headline: Equities tumble as rate worries, geopolitical tensions wear on
n523606c92c.summary: MSCI's emerging markets equity index fell 0.9% to its lowest level in eleven months. Investors cited lingering geopolitical uncertainty and expectations that US monetary conditions will stay tight for longer.
n523606c92c.why: Emerging market equities are sensitive to US interest rate expectations, because higher US yields tend to pull capital away from riskier markets. The MSCI Emerging Markets index is a widely used benchmark for these stocks.
n523606c92c.why_moved: Investors cited expectations that US monetary conditions will remain tight for longer and lingering geopolitical uncertainty linked to the Israel-Hamas conflict. Higher expected US rates tend to reduce appetite for emerging market assets.
